title: Project scaffold + safety core (allowlist, secrets, gitignore)
acceptance_criteria: git repo has .gitignore committed first; it ignores node_modules/, Playwright browsers, .env.test, __pycache__, *.pyc, report output dirs
authagent/ Python package with module entry stub (python -m authagent --help works); requirements.txt pins playwright, pyyaml, requests, pytest; README notes playwright install chromium
config/allowlist.yaml exists with defaults localhost, 127.0.0.1, *.test and a place for user-added hosts
A single allowlist chokepoint function parses a URL host and REFUSES (raises/returns refusal, never proceeds) any host not matching allowlist incl wildcard *.test; localhost and 127.0.0.1 allowed
Unit test proves refusal: allowed hosts pass, a non-allowlisted host (e.g. example.com) is refused; pytest green

.env.test.example committed; a secrets/credential helper writes generated creds only to gitignored .env.test seed and a redaction utility guarantees creds never reach logs/stdout/reports; unit test covers redaction
